title: Hello world
body: This is a throwaway test post to confirm the blog system works end to end. It hijacks the homepage layout exactly: the title up top, the date on the right, the photo alongside it, and a Back link where “now playing” usually sits.

Everything you’re reading is stored in posts.json and rendered at build time. To take this page down, open /admin, select this post, and hit Delete (or just uncheck Published). It’ll 404 on the next deploy.
